proves.claim: nextFor given a derived seat-family answer uses it for the seat and builder families of the review family check.

store.next.derived-seat-family-used.why: Without it, a regression where nextFor ignores the derived seat families would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: Without the answer, or for an id it does not name, nextFor computes the families as before and offers the same item.

store.next.derived-seat-family-fallback.why: Without it, a regression where a missing derived answer changes the item next offers would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: nextFor reads the derived seat-family option beside the derived gate-at-head option from the same options.

store.next.derived-seat-family-beside-ga.why: Without it, a regression where the two derived options stop working together would pass unnoticed.
